summary: Production Workflow + Timeline Audit testing completed (iteration 58). All 23 backend API tests passed covering: GET/PUT /api/production-timeline/settings (workflow_mode, category_template_map), POST /api/production-timeline/enable with simple/detailed mode switching, GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/history with unified timeline events, timeline advance/edit flows, and no regression on Jobs/Approvals/Pricing routes. Frontend testing passed: Production Settings page loads with Workflow Mode selector (Simple/Detailed/Custom options), Save button works with success toast, Workflow Templates and Analytics tabs visible, Job Details page shows View Timeline button, Job History panel opens with filter dropdown (All Events, Production Stages, etc.), history events show with production stage started/completed entries.

GET /api/production-timeline/settings.description: Returns workflow_mode (simple/detailed/custom) and category_template_map for tenant

PUT /api/production-timeline/settings.description: Saves workflow_mode and category_template_map - persists to tenant-specific settings

POST /api/production-timeline/enable wit.description: Creates timeline with 3 stages (Design, Production, Installation/Completion) when workflow_mode=simple
Creates timeline with 8+ stages including Job Created, Artwork Uploaded, Print, Laminate, etc. when workflow_mode=detailed

GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/history.description: Returns unified array of events in reverse chronological order with id, event_type, title, timestamp, filter_group, user_name, related_type, related_id

Job history filter groups.description: Valid filter_group values: general, production, artwork, customer, financial, documents

POST /api/production-timeline/{id}/advan.description: Advances timeline to next stage, returns new_stage_order and is_completed flag

GET /api/production-timeline/templates.description: Returns workflow templates (default and custom) for tenant

Frontend: Settings > Production page.description: Page loads at /settings/production with Workflow Mode selector and Save button

Frontend: Workflow Mode selector.description: Dropdown shows Simple Workflow, Detailed Workflow, Custom Workflow options

Frontend: Save Workflow Mode button.description: Save button triggers API call, shows 'Workflow mode saved' toast on success

Frontend: Workflow Templates tab.description: Shows list of templates (Vehicle Wrap 12 stages, Printed Signs 10 stages, etc.) with stage editor

Frontend: Analytics tab.description: Production analytics tab visible in Production Settings

Frontend: Job Details - View Timeline bu.description: View Timeline button visible and clickable on job details page (data-testid=view-job-history-btn)

Frontend: Job History Panel.description: Panel opens showing Job Timeline / History with events list

Frontend: History filter dropdown.description: Filter dropdown with All Events, Production Stages, Artwork/Proofs, Customer Actions, Financial Events, Documents, General options

Frontend: History events display.description: Events show with title, badge for filter_group, user name, timestamp, duration (for production stages)

No regression on /approvals.description: Artwork Approvals page loads correctly with approval requests table

No regression on /pricing-calculator.description: Pricing Calculator page loads with all category tiles (Promotional Items, Cut Vinyl, Services, etc.)

No regression on Jobs page.description: Jobs list with filters (All Jobs, Quotes, Active, Completed, Invoiced, Archived) working correctly

Line item Timeline column.description: Job details Line Items table shows Timeline column with stage status button (e.g., 'Installation / Compl...')
